#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cassert>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

class G {
public:
    void submit() {
        int n, k, s;
        long long t;
        cin >> n >> k >> s >> t;
        s--; // because Java reads nextInt() - 1
        cout << solve(n, k, s, t) + 1 << endl;
    }

    int solve(int n, int k, int s, long long t) {
        s = reduce(n, k, s, t);
        t /= n;

        vector<long long> when(n, -1);

        for (long long left = t; left > 0; left--) {
            if (when[s] != -1) {
                long long period = when[s] - left;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (when[i] != -1 && when[i] <= when[s] && when[i] % period == 0) {
                        return i;
                    }
                }
                assert(false);
            }
            when[s] = left;
            for (int i = n - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                if (s < k) {
                    s += i;
                    if (s >= n) s -= n;
                } else {
                    s -= i;
                    if (s < 0) s += n;
                }
            }
        }
        return s;
    }

    int reduce(int n, int k, int s, long long t) {
        while (t % n != 0) {
            int delta = (s < k ? 1 : -1) * (t % n);
            s = (s + n + delta) % n;
            t--;
        }
        return s;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    cout.tie(0);
    G g;
    g.submit();
    return 0;
}
